subject.title: fix(agents): stop runs at the critical tool-loop threshold

question: Should loopDetectionPreToolUseRelay=false preserve its historical PreToolUse-only opt-out, or become the supported opt-out for the full loop-detection PreToolUse/PostToolUse relay pair?
rationale: This is an existing user-facing configuration contract, and the PR discussion identifies two plausible semantics with different compatibility consequences; source review cannot safely choose the product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve the narrow legacy opt-out
options.body: Keep false as an opt-out for the loop-detection PreToolUse relay while retaining any independently required post-tool relays, and align docs and focused tests to that contract.

options.title: Adopt a paired loop-relay opt-out
options.body: Explicitly make false disable both loop-detection relay stages, document the upgrade behavior, and provide focused proof that required non-loop post-tool behavior remains intact.

recommendation.title: Preserve the narrow legacy opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep false as an opt-out for the loop-detection PreToolUse relay while retaining any independently required post-tool relays, and align docs and focused tests to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main ownership trail was available in the supplied review context for this cross-harness compatibility decision.
